Spotter privacy: no accounts, no analytics, only pub.dev

Last updated 6 November 2026.

The app

Spotter has no accounts and no analytics. It makes no network calls except to pub.dev, which it needs in order to find new releases.

pub.dev is a third party. It receives those requests the way any website does, and its own policies apply.

Spotter sends nothing to us, so there is nothing for us to keep or delete, and no consent to withdraw.

This website

This site loads no JavaScript and no analytics. It sets no cookies and has no forms. The company that hosts it may keep normal server logs.

The download link goes to GitHub, where GitHub's own policies apply.

Questions

Open an issue on GitHub.
